loadError: The web could not be loaded.
howToReadText: Rings run from the center out. Select any tile to see what it is and what it connects to; tiles with a corner badge open their own web.
dragHint: Drag to pan · pinch or Ctrl + scroll to zoom
growTheWeb: Press Play to grow the web year by year.
todayCaption: The whole web as it stands today.
searchNone: Nothing matches. Try a person, a group, an icon or a verb like "styles".
searchHelp: Type a name, a group, an icon or a verb like "styles".
freshAbout: How recently the code behind a tile changed: the last commit on main to its path. A filled corner dot means main has changed more than 14 days after the last release, so a release is due. Faded tiles have no code path to check.
freshDue: Main has changed since the last release.
freshDueKey: with a release due: main changed 14+ days after the last release
busAbout: How many people besides the maintainers are connected to each code part, by any kind of connection in any web. Only code parts count (a repo or npm link, or a release); other tiles are faded. The corner badge shows the count.
busNone: Only the maintainers are connected to it.
impactAbout: How much else touches a tile: its distinct connections across every web it appears in. Bands split this web into thirds.
evidenceAbout: How well a tile is backed up: a cited source, links, and evidence on its connections.
evidenceText: {n} pieces of evidence: sources, links and connection evidence.
evidenceNone: No source, links or connection evidence yet.
parityAbout: From the parity run: three dots per feature, left to right: API pair (Node.js and PHP), CLI, Agent. A filled dot matches; an open dot has a gap to close. The surfaces compared get a plain ring; planned parts a dashed one.
parityApiAbout: For each API operation: whether the PHP and Node.js backends both implement it, and whether the CLI and the MCP server call it. Faded tiles are not API operations.
paritySurface: One of the surfaces the parity run compares: the same seeded operations go to each, and the sites they write are compared.
parityPlanned: Planned. When it lands it joins the parity run on every surface.
parityDotsKey: filled matches, open has a gap, small not measured
parityOp: PHP backend: {php}. Node.js backend: {nodejs}. CLI calls it: {cli}. MCP calls it: {mcp}.
reuseAbout: How much of HAX builds on a tile's code: how many other element packages import its package, and how many themes load any of its files. Only tiles that are element packages are measured; other tiles are faded. The corner badge shows the package count.
reuseA: Built on widely: 5+ packages or most themes
reuseB: Used by a few packages or themes
reuseText: {package} is imported by {n} other packages and loaded by {themes} of {total} themes.
weightAbout: What a tile's code costs a visitor: everything its package's main file loads, gzipped, with third-party code left out, and the part of that a site with the shared theme core does not already have. Bands go by that added part. Only tiles that are element packages are measured; other tiles are faded.
weightText: {package}: its own file is {gz}; it loads {load} in all, {adds} of it beyond the shared core.
authorHelp: The web is two files in PRAW: Mermaid for its structure and JSON for descriptions, links, evidence, tours and years. Edit them there; this view shows what the element read.
noProblems: No problems found in this web.
